meta.name: Allow the combined tax recipient factory (combo-v1)
meta.description: GangHandlerAdmin.setFactory(GangComboSplitterFactory 0xd33C38BE3f8472b3013167830F0638C1704e1DBd, true): its clones (combo-v1) split a V3 token's tax into a buy-back share (bought and burned to 0xdead in chunks), a liquidity share (added to its PancakeSwap pair in chunks, LP to 0xdead) and fixed shares for up to 10 payees. Source verified on BscScan. Existing factories are not changed. gang-launchpad PR #95.
